label.text: A recovery code just got you into Darpan (${at}). Phone missing? Battery dead? Happens to the best of us. That's exactly what they're for.
You have ${recoveryCodesLeft} left. When you're down to the last few, make a fresh set in User Settings. Spare keys work best when there are spares.
Not you? Change your password now and tell your Darpan administrator.
